Title: XPerience
Description: Level up by playing: earn XP for farming, fighting, crafting and building, then spend points on stats and skills. XPerience has its own full help menu in game.
HowTo: Play normally — gathering, fighting and building all earn XP.
Type /xpstats to open your profile and spend points.
Type /xphelp for the full XPerience guide and command list.
Notes: This is a third-party plugin with its own menus — /xphelp covers everything.
